details.description: Dynamic batching is a processing strategy for Google Cloud Speech-to-Text v2's batch (asynchronous) recognition, selected via the BatchRecognizeRequest processing_strategy field set to DYNAMIC_BATCHING. Google documents it as enabling lower-cost transcription in exchange for higher latency, and states it is only available for batch recognition of audio already stored in Cloud Storage, not for streaming or synchronous requests.
advantages: Google documents dynamic batching as enabling lower-cost transcription compared to standard batch processing.
disadvantages: Google documents dynamic batching as trading lower cost for higher latency.
Only available for batch (asynchronous) recognition of audio stored in Cloud Storage, not for streaming or synchronous recognition.
use_cases: Cost-sensitive, non-time-sensitive transcription of long audio files stored in Cloud Storage

sources.title: Transcribe using batch recognition | Cloud Speech-to-Text V2

notes: This entry is a processing strategy/option of Speech-to-Text v2 batch recognition (DYNAMIC_BATCHING), not a distinct acoustic model with its own language list or accuracy figures; none were published on the source page, so evaluations and languages are left empty rather than guessed.
